title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 2: the call of the son of man, the rebellious house and the scroll of lamentations.

questions.text: In the first verse, what does the voice tell him to do before it will speak with him?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 2:1 says the voice told him, "Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you."

answers.text: Cover his face with his hands

questions.text: How does the voice address him throughout this chapter?
questions.explanation: In Ezekiel 2:1 and 2:3 the voice calls him "Son of man" each time it speaks to him.

questions.text: What set him on his feet when the voice spoke to him?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 2:2 says the Spirit entered into him when he spoke to him and set him on his feet.

answers.text: A hand took him by a lock of his hair
The wind of the storm pushed him up

questions.text: To whom does the voice say he is sending him?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 2:3 says he is sent to the children of Israel, a nation of rebels who have rebelled against God.

answers.text: To the children of Israel, a nation of rebels
To the land of the Chaldeans by the river
To the nations that are around Israel
To the kings of the earth and their princes

questions.text: What words is he to say to them when he speaks?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 2:4 says he shall tell them, "This is what the Lord Yahweh says."

answers.text: "Peace be with you, house of Israel"
"Repent now and you will surely live"
"This is what the Lord Yahweh says"
"Hear, O Israel, and be glad in your king"

questions.text: How are the children he is sent to described in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 2:4 calls the children impudent and stiff-hearted.

questions.text: Whether they hear or refuse, what will they know?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 2:5 says that whether they hear or refuse, they will know that there has been a prophet among them.

answers.text: That there has been a prophet among them
That their city will stand forever
That Yahweh has forsaken the land
That the prophet speaks his own words

questions.text: Among what does the voice say he dwells, telling him not to be afraid?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 2:6 says that though briers and thorns are with him and he dwells among scorpions, he must not be afraid of them.

questions.text: What did he see in the hand that was stretched out to him?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 2:9 says a hand was stretched out to him, and a scroll of a book was in it.

questions.text: What was written in the scroll that was spread before him?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 2:10 says it was written within and without, and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.
